cardinality_invariant.explanation: Each saved family starts with one injective element-preserving mapping. A local relation is a bijection between its fixed source and target sets; its source and target self choices are permutations. A placement action is a target permutation applied to the entire continuation. The ordered evaluator changes target images without adding or removing source keys. Hence every represented physical mapping has the same mapped heavy-atom cardinality as family.mapping. Endpoint chemical equivalence also preserves elements and cardinality.
